cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — standing; inside a knightly order's campaign pavilion — sets a cup down on the surface in front of her; an empty modern wave-training pool at a coastal sports laboratory — she guides a floating hoop across a gentle wave with both hands while standing in the shallow lane; a Roman marble bath hall — plays a guzheng zither laid across her lap or a low table; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a modern community rehearsal hall after a dance class — she rewinds a rehearsal cassette by turning its spool with a pencil; a penthouse window wall over the city at night — standing; a Guan Yu temple — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; a riverside pavilion tower over the Yangtze — lights the candle inside a small red paper lantern; her tower bedchamber in a stone castle — standing; a snowy mountain-lodge terrace with a wooden railing and benches above a winter valley — kneeling on the ground; a night observatory under an open dome — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a hotel suite with a city view and an open suitcase — reads a book held open in both hands
